### Let Some Love – Art house animation screening @ NCF Cultural Co-op, Ballina

![Let Some Love](valentine-film.png)

**Saturday February 14th** /
**Start: 8pm**

**Age: 21+**

A mind-blowing programme of international short films about love, lovemaking, romantic tensions and painful one-sided affections – all these with electrifying humour and sunny spells of honesty.

This event is for all singles who hate this date and February in general. As all couples will be in restaurants and similar cringy places, we will be able to have scientific symposium, do some research and wash our eyes with liquid happiness. Well ok, love birds are also welcome!

- Programme duration: 67 mins
- **This show is BYOB (no glass please)**
- Free entrance
